## Check 2 — SHA-256 Tamper Detection

**Commands:** `printf ... > sha256-demo.txt`, `sha256sum sha256-demo.txt`, append one line, then `sha256sum sha256-demo.txt` again.

~~~text
Original SHA-256: 57df263abee0e162ab8cf012559d47ff6226c7cb9b1e821724c01e2422206c22
Modified SHA-256: f31173244f622da653bf07c1ba3f9e90525ded275254fb0b833005c83ed91c76
Result: DIFFER (PASS)
~~~

**Firmware integrity significance:** A trusted vendor-published SHA-256 or, preferably, a verified vendor digital signature detects firmware tampering before installation; two locally computed hashes alone cannot establish publisher authenticity.
